title: Stockfish, But It Alternates 250 ELO to 3600 ELO Every Capture
summary: 'Alternate Fish': the bot starts as Stockfish (3600) and toggles between playing like Stockfish and like Martin (250) every time IT captures a piece. Player (white) deliberately offers pawns (e.g. e4, b4) so Stockfish captures and hands control to Martin, then exploits Martin's weak moves; a later Martin recapture hands control back to Stockfish. Player promotes, gains a queen-size material lead and wins with a checkmate in one game. Bot game rating estimated at ~1400.
rules: Each time the BOT captures a piece, it switches mode: Stockfish (3600) <-> Martin (250).
Player captures do not toggle the bot (only the bot's captures).
Display which personality is currently playing.

Official site: counter of BOT captures; odd count -> Tony (250) personality (plays mate-in-1 if available, otherwise weak moves), even -> Stockfish 3600. Site title 'Stockfish, But It Alternates Between 0 ELO and 3600 ELO'.
